description: Selected thirteen common-course configurations: reference, familiar flyweight change, spring-rate and admissible ramp-shape cases, isolated secondary change, adverse cases, and a mechanism-resolved D02 intervention family including a high-primary-force over-correction diagnostic.

competitors.label: Baja reference
competitors.intent: Unchanged reference hardware; the common point of comparison.

competitors.label: Tip hardware 85%
competitors.intent: Change centrifugal closing and its consistent inertia together; spring and geometry unchanged. Higher/lower working speed is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed performance gain.

competitors.label: Primary spring rate 3x
competitors.intent: Strong rate contrast; test rising work-speed characteristic and possible incomplete shift; installed preload is explicitly adjusted at engagement geometry.

competitors.label: Ramp arc tail 10 deg
competitors.intent: Keep first 10 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a arc tail ending at 10 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.

competitors.label: Ramp 26 deg, 7 mm blend
competitors.intent: Keep the first 10 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 7 mm, then use an arc tail ending at 26 degrees. Selected from the frozen-environment RC28 replacement screen as an admissible falling working-speed characteristic.

competitors.label: Ramp arc tail 40 deg late
competitors.intent: Keep first 18 mm of the physical ramp unchanged, C3-blend over 5 mm, then use a arc tail ending at 40 degrees. Test a change of shift-curve shape, not a centrifugal-force scale.

competitors.label: Helix 28 deg
competitors.intent: Change the same constant-angle helix, measured from the circumferential direction; torque sensitivity and reflected shift inertia both change. Radius and preload unchanged.

competitors.label: Very-light-tip flat-limit probe
competitors.intent: Larger single-knob mass reduction: distinguish persistent under-shifting from merely late high-ratio arrival.

competitors.label: Premature-shift stress control
competitors.intent: Intentionally adverse hypothesis: early primary closing and weak secondary opposition may pull the engine down under load.

competitors.label: Late-engagement stress control
competitors.intent: Intentionally adverse hypothesis: weak centrifugal closing against high preload may delay engagement or maintain primary slip.

competitors.label: D02: restore reference tip mass
competitors.intent: One-change intervention on D02: restore tip mass and its consistent mass moments while retaining the 115% primary preload. Assess traction, launch and shifting; no improvement is imposed.

competitors.label: D02: 150% tip mass
competitors.intent: High-primary-force intervention on D02: increase replaceable tip mass to 150% while retaining the 115% primary preload. Test whether stronger centrifugal closing restores traction but resists severe-hill backshift; no outcome is imposed.

competitors.label: D02: restore reference primary preload
competitors.intent: One-change intervention on D02: retain 65% tips but restore reference primary spring compression. Distinguish a lower spring opposition from increasing centrifugal actuation.

selection_note: W115 and B01 remain available in exploration but are not part of the selected final fleet; P300, RC10 and RC40L are retained from the shift-shape exploration, R26B7 replaces the RC28 definition rejected by the frozen CINDER 1.1.2 construction audit, and D02_M150 is the selected high-primary-force diagnostic on the D02 repair axis.
